title: Psalm 12
opening_line: Help, LORD, because the godly man

source.note: Received text from the official Free Church digital edition and plain-text archive.

text.diplomatic: Help, LORD, because the godly man
text.normalized: Help, LORD, because the godly man
text.reading: Help, LORD, because the godly man

text.diplomatic: doth daily fade away;
text.normalized: Doth daily fade away;
text.reading: doth daily fade away;

text.diplomatic: And from among the sons of men
text.normalized: And from among the sons of men
text.reading: And from among the sons of men

text.diplomatic: the faithful do decay.
text.normalized: The faithful do decay.
text.reading: the faithful do decay.

text.diplomatic: Unto his neighbour everyone
text.normalized: Unto his neighbour everyone
text.reading: Unto his neighbour everyone

text.diplomatic: doth utter vanity:
text.normalized: Doth utter vanity:
text.reading: doth utter vanity:

text.diplomatic: They with a double heart do speak,
text.normalized: They with a double heart do speak,
text.reading: They with a double heart do speak,

text.diplomatic: and lips of flattery.
text.normalized: And lips of flattery.
text.reading: and lips of flattery.

text.diplomatic: GOD shall cut off all flatt’ring lips,
text.normalized: GOD shall cut off all flatt’ring lips,
text.reading: GOD shall cut off all flatt’ring lips,

text.diplomatic: tongues that speak proudly thus,
text.normalized: Tongues that speak proudly thus,
text.reading: tongues that speak proudly thus,

text.diplomatic: We’ll with our tongue prevail, our lips
text.normalized: We’ll with our tongue prevail, our lips
text.reading: We’ll with our tongue prevail, our lips

text.diplomatic: are ours: who’s lord o’er us?
text.normalized: Are ours: who’s lord o’er us?
text.reading: are ours: who’s lord o’er us?

text.diplomatic: For poor oppressed, and for the sighs
text.normalized: For poor oppressed, and for the sighs
text.reading: For poor oppressed, and for the sighs

text.diplomatic: of needy, rise will I,
text.normalized: Of needy, rise will I,
text.reading: of needy, rise will I,

text.diplomatic: Saith GOD, and him in safety set
text.normalized: Saith GOD, and him in safety set
text.reading: Saith GOD, and him in safety set

text.diplomatic: from such as him defy.
text.normalized: From such as him defy.
text.reading: from such as him defy.

text.diplomatic: The words of GOD are words most pure;
text.normalized: The words of GOD are words most pure;
text.reading: The words of GOD are words most pure;

text.diplomatic: they be like silver tried
text.normalized: They be like silver tried
text.reading: they be like silver tried

text.diplomatic: In earthen furnace, seven times
text.normalized: In earthen furnace, seven times
text.reading: In earthen furnace, seven times

text.diplomatic: that hath been purified.
text.normalized: That hath been purified.
text.reading: that hath been purified.

text.diplomatic: LORD, thou shalt them preserve and keep
text.normalized: LORD, thou shalt them preserve and keep
text.reading: LORD, thou shalt them preserve and keep

text.diplomatic: for ever from this race.
text.normalized: For ever from this race.
text.reading: for ever from this race.

text.diplomatic: On each side walk the wicked, when
text.normalized: On each side walk the wicked, when
